description:
At his adoptive father’s urging, Tae-min reluctantly agrees to go on a blind date. But the person who shows up is none other than his beloved younger brother, Ji-ho.

*“Are you Mr. Lee Tae-min?”  
“What are you doing here?”  
“I’m here for the blind date. I like you, hyung.”  
“…I’ve never liked you that way.”*

Tae-min rejects Ji-ho’s confession, but something in his chest feels uneasy. The next day, he wakes up completely naked—locked up in an unfamiliar room by someone.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/turn_away), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/uncomfortable_disregard)

**Official Translations:**
